 How to Watch Kings vs Clippers
 When: Wednesday, October 21, 2026
 Time: 10:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: NBC Sports California, NBC Sports California Plus
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Sacramento opens its regular season following a 126-97 preseason loss to the San Antonio Spurs on Friday, finishing its exhibition schedule with an 0-5 record. Zach LaVine led the Kings with 19 points, three rebounds and three assists, while Ben Simmons contributed 15 points, eight rebounds and six assists. Darius Acuff Jr. added 13 points, and Domantas Sabonis recorded 11 points and 10 rebounds. Sacramento fell behind 71-37 at halftime and struggled to recover despite scoring 35 points in the third quarter, closing out a brutal preseason.
 Los Angeles enters its season opener after defeating the Denver Nuggets 122-110 on Wednesday, ending the preseason with a 2-1 record. Rui Hachimura paced the Clippers with 16 points and five rebounds, making three of his five 3-point attempts, while Baba Miller added 15 points and five rebounds. Darius Garland contributed 14 points and seven assists, and Derrick Jones Jr. finished with 14 points and five rebounds. The Clippers outscored Denver 38-26 in the third quarter to take control of the contest, building a 15-point advantage and cruising to victory.
